WITH per_group AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    site.typesite,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, site.typesite
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_of_group_avg_pressratio,
  AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS avg_of_group_avg_size_per_minute
FROM per_group;

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration is treated as undefined for size per minute, so that ratio is ignored along with other missing values.
